'''Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty''' is the 31st Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher on 31 October 2001. It is 200 cards (100 per side): 42 very rare foils, 54 super rare foils, 4 ultra rare foils, and 100 non-foil premiums. CardGuide numbering: 31st product (CardGuide lists 113 unique-to-list cards).

Packs are 18 cards, MSRP $4.95, 30 packs per box. Random reprint slots from Premiere through Endor are not listed.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>

== Print sheets ==
Foils and premiums are 11&times;11 (121 cards). Foil sheet: 2 ultra rares once each, 21 very rares 3&times; or 2&times;, 27 super rares 2&times;, 1 blank, and 1 tournament foil 4&times; ([[Qui-Gon Jinn With Lightsaber]] / [[Darth Maul With Lightsaber]]). Premium sheets mix 2&times; and 3&times; titles; Dark Side objectives print on the Light premium sheet.<ref name="encyc" />
